reply.text:
POTS is a medical condition, so how much cardio is right for you, and in what form, is one for your doctor or whoever manages it, not a coach. I won't guess at it, because the right approach depends on your case.

Once they've told you what's cleared, bring it back to me. I'll build your training around it, whether that's a plan that fits their limits or one that avoids certain positions or intensities. Tell me what they say to avoid and I'll work from there.
